name: Avatar
purpose: Represents a user or entity in a compact, typically circular form. Three content variants — an uploaded image, the user's initials, or a placeholder icon — in three sizes, with on-light and on-dark treatments.

This ruling DISSOLVES the intent-map vocab gate on this row -- the vocabulary itself remains unruled/Dave's, but no longer blocks this verdict. variants.name: image
variants.use: Avatar showing an uploaded photo; image opacity 100% default / 20% disabled (image/opacity tokens).

variants.name: initials
variants.use: Avatar showing the user's initials in medium-weight text on a subtle surface.

variants.name: icon
variants.use: Placeholder avatar showing a generic person icon when no image/initials available.

tokens.$finding: (2026-06-19) Avatar is ROUND (angular-rule exemption, with Badge). Deprecated non-interactive surface/border rebind to live tertiary/background/hover (surface) + border/subtle (ring). Initials = text/default; interactive avatars need a focus ring (2.4.7).
